mapper.select:
SELECT distinct FEE_ID AS feeId, FEE_NAME AS feeName, APPLY_TYPE AS applyType, FEE_TYPE AS feeType, ORG_TYPE AS orgType, ORG_TYPE2 AS orgType2, CHARGE_TYPE AS chargeType, BASIC_BILL AS basicBill, BASIS AS basis, REMARK AS remark FROM MST_FEEINFO WHERE 1=1
AND FEE_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{feeName}),'%')
AND FEE_TYPE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{feeType}),'%')
ORDER BY FEE_NAME DESC

SELECT distinct FEE_ID AS code, FEE_NAME AS shortName FROM MST_FEEINFO WHERE 1=1
AND FEE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{feeName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))

SELECT distinct FEE_ID AS feeId, FEE_NAME AS feeName, APPLY_TYPE AS applyType, FEE_TYPE AS feeType, ORG_TYPE AS orgType, ORG_TYPE2 AS orgType2, CHARGE_TYPE AS chargeType, BASIC_BILL AS basicBill, BASIS AS basis, ORG_TYPE2 orgType2, REMARK AS remark FROM MST_FEEINFO WHERE FEE_ID = #{feeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

WITH R1 AS (SELECT COUNT (*) COT FROM TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL FIN,MST_FEEINFO MST WHERE FIN.FEE_ID=MST.FEE_ID AND MST.FEE_ID=#{feeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ,R2 AS (SELECT COUNT (*) COT FROM FIN_CASH_INFO FIN,MST_FEEINFO MST WHERE FIN.FEE_ID=MST.FEE_ID AND MST.FEE_ID=#{feeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) SELECT
SUM(R1.COT+R2.COT) cnt FROM R1,R2

SELECT distinct FEE_ID AS feeId, FEE_NAME AS feeName, APPLY_TYPE AS applyType, FEE_TYPE AS feeType, ORG_TYPE AS orgType, ORG_TYPE2 AS orgType2, CHARGE_TYPE AS chargeType, BASIC_BILL AS basicBill, BASIS AS basis, ORG_TYPE2 orgType2, REMARK AS remark FROM MST_FEEINFO WHERE FEE_NAME = #{feeName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT distinct MF.FEE_ID AS feeId, MF.FEE_NAME AS feeName, MF.APPLY_TYPE AS applyType, MF.FEE_TYPE AS feeType, MF.ORG_TYPE AS orgType, MF.ORG_TYPE2 AS orgType2, MF.CHARGE_TYPE AS chargeType, MF.BASIC_BILL AS basicBill, MF.BASIS AS basis, MF.ORG_TYPE2 orgType2, MF.REMARK AS remark FROM MST_FEEINFO MF INNER JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT SD on sd.dept_code = MF.create_dept WHERE MF.FEE_NAME = #{feeName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SD.INSTITUTION_CODE= #{institutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
